svg.title: The reversal at longer sequences disappears; cost still grows
svg.desc: Left: improvement over the best single dataflow against sequence length. The original action space turns negative at sequence 512; the per-stage action space stays positive. Right: search wall-clock cost, which grows with sequence length and is higher for the per-stage action space because it makes three simulator calls per candidate.

g.text: improvement over the best single dataflow
At L = 512 the original run lost to the best static dataflow (−1.6 %); five of five seeds now converge, with the same six-iteration budget.

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp4_scalability/results/processed/ (exp4_ and exp4_perstage_ scalability_summary) · 32×32 array, n = 5 seeds · bars = 95 % CI
